tickets.title: Convert schema registry into executable schemas
tickets.objective: Create executable schema definitions for Brain data objects and validation tests.
acceptance_criteria: all canonical objects have executable schemas
tickets.go_hold_condition: GO only when tests and acceptance report exist

tickets.title: Implement formula registry runtime
tickets.objective: Create executable formula registry and tests for attention, belief, reward, pain, trust and capital formula families.
acceptance_criteria: each formula has service and test
each formula run emits audit evidence
tickets.go_hold_condition: HOLD if any formula lacks owner, service, table/store, dashboard, or test

tickets.title: Materialize fixture and replay harness
tickets.objective: Create fixture-driven replay tests for source to outcome to learning loop.
tickets.go_hold_condition: GO only after deterministic replay passes

tickets.title: Build contradiction review workflow
tickets.objective: Preserve contradictions as auditable review items instead of resolving them silently.
acceptance_criteria: both sides of a conflict are retained
user decision required status is supported
tickets.go_hold_condition: HOLD if contradiction material is deleted or silently merged

tickets.title: Enforce acceptance matrix in CI
tickets.objective: Add CI validation that fails when agent-control docs, fixtures, traceability, or acceptance statuses are missing.
tickets.go_hold_condition: GO only when CI gate exists and passes

tickets.title: Create source-to-build traceability matrix
tickets.objective: Map Brain source concepts to modules, schemas, services, formulas, tests, fixtures, dashboards and acceptance evidence.
acceptance_criteria: each build module has source reference
each task maps to at least one module
tickets.go_hold_condition: HOLD if any build task lacks source traceability
